description: Recommend which Nodecraft plan to buy for a game, sized by player count, how modded the server is, and whether it must stay online 24/7, with its price and a checkout link. Works without signing in. Call it only when the user asks which plan fits, what to buy, or what hosting a game costs. If `unanswered` lists questions, ask the user them and call again before sharing the link. The link only opens checkout: the user pays themselves, so never say anything was bought.

currency.description: Currency for prices and checkout. Defaults to "usd".

game.description: The game, as a slug (e.g. "valheim", "minecraft") or its name (e.g. "Valheim").

mods.description: How modded the server will be: "none" for vanilla, "some" for a few mods or plugins, "heavy" for big modpacks or heavy roleplay frameworks. The game's own wording comes back in `unanswered`.

players.description: How many players will usually be on at once.

uptime.description: "while_playing" for a Lite server that hibernates when nobody is on and wakes on demand, or "always_on" for a Pro server that runs 24/7 with a static IP.

name: recommend_plan
title: Recommend a Server Plan
